## Outcome and ownership
- Goal / human beneficiary (if product-facing):
- Human owner + implementing agent/tool (if any):
- Base SHA / branch / exclusive files:
- Related issue or contract version (if relevant):

## Evidence-backed handoff
- Changes and reason:
- Exact commands **actually run** + observed result (or **not run**, with why):
- One input/output fixture, simulated sensor/action trace or failing reproduction:
- Baseline / changed-scene scenario (if relevant):
- Unverified assumptions, risk and rollback path:

## Before merge (human integrator)
- [ ] Scope and paths don't overwrite another worker; latest base reviewed
- [ ] Shared contracts/version + callers updated together, if changed
- [ ] Independent test or review; end-to-end scenario rerun when product-facing
- [ ] Robotics claims trace to real sensors; impact/critical failure evidence is credible
- [ ] No secret, private organiser/team content, unlicensed assets or unsupported performance claim
- [ ] Cloud spend, deployment and final submission still require explicit human approval

For tiny independent fixes, keep sections short. A filled template is **not** proof tests ran or that a human approved the merge.
